Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Extra Gooey Cinnamon Rolls (Bakery-Style & No-Knead) Dough * 1 tsp yeast * 2 tbsp sugar * 343 g milk (about 1½ cups) * 480 g flour (about 4 cups + 2 tbsp) * 1 tsp salt * 60 g softened butter (about 4 tbsp) Filling * 140 g softened butter (10 tbsp) * 140 g brown sugar (about ⅔ cup) * 3½ tbsp ground cinnamon Butter Vanilla Frosting * 85 g softened butter (6 tbsp) * 180 g powdered sugar (about 1½ cups) * 1 tbsp vanilla extract Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the yeast, sugar, and milk. Add the flour and mix until combined. Add the salt and softened butter, then stretch and fold (or coil fold) until the butter is fully incorporated. 2. Cover and let the dough rise for about 2 hours, or until doubled in size. 3. Roll the dough into a large rectangle. Spread the softened butter evenly over the dough, then sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon. 4. Cut the dough into 6 long strips, then roll each strip into a cinnamon roll. 5. Sprinkle a little of the cinnamon sugar mixture into the bottom of the pan, then place the rolls on top. 6. Cover and let them rest for 15 minutes. 7. Mix a little milk with 1 tbsp melted butter, then spoon about 2 tbsp of the mixture over each cinnamon roll. 8. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25–30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. As soon as they come out of the oven, cover them with a clean kitchen towel until warm. Then spread the frosting on top. That’s the key to extra-soft cinnamon rolls. #cinnamonrolls #cinnamonroll #baking #bread #breadtok

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Cheesy Caramelized Onion Dip with Crispy Bacon ❤️‍🔥 It’s cozy, it’s warm, and it’s incredibly delicious.  If you’re looking for a side/dip to bring to Friendsgiving or Thanksgiving, make this one.  Trust me, it’ll be gone in minutes.  Here’s how to make it:  1 lb thick-cut bacon, cut into small pieces 2 yellow onions, sliced 2 shallots, sliced Pinch of salt Water (for caramelizing) 8 oz cream cheese, softened 1 cup sour cream, room temp 1/2 cup mayo, room temp 4 oz sharp cheddar, shredded 4 oz mozzarella, shredded 2 oz mozzarella, shredded (to top) 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce Freshly cracked pepper, to taste 6 cloves garlic, minced 1-2 tsp fresh thyme 1-2 tsp balsamic vinegar 1 tsp brown sugar Crispy fried onions (for topping) 1. Cook the bacon in a large pot or skillet over medium/high heat until crispy. 2. Remove the bacon and set it aside, leaving 1/4 cup of the bacon grease in the pan. 3. Add the sliced onions and shallots to the pan with a pinch of salt and a splash of water. Cook over medium/high heat. 4. Continue adding splashes of water throughout the cooking process to prevent the onions from burning. Stir frequently until the onions and shallots are caramelized (about 40-50 minutes). 5. While the onions are caramelizing, combine the cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, shredded cheddar, 4oz shredded mozzarella, Worcestershire sauce, salt, freshly cracked pepper, and the crispy bacon (save some bacon for topping). Mix and set aside. 6. In the last 2–3 minutes of caramelizing, add the garlic, fresh thyme, balsamic vinegar, and brown sugar. Stir until well combined. 7. Let the caramelized onions and shallots cool slightly before mixing them into the cheese mixture. 8. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, top with the remaining mozzarella, and sprinkle with the reserved crispy bacon. 9. Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes, then top with crispy fried onions and finish under the broiler for 2–3 minutes, until golden and bubbly. 10. Serve with your favoritr crackers and enjoy!  #easyrecipe #sides #side #thanksgivingfood #holidayfood #holidayrecipes #thanksgiving #thanksgivingsides #friendsgiving #oniondip #dips #thanksgivingdinner

INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

One-Pan Chicken & Potatoes 🥘  FULL RECIPE: Ingredients: 	- 30ml olive oil 	- 2 tsp minced garlic 	- 2 tsp chicken seasoning        - 1 tsp mixed herbs  	- 1 tsp paprika        - 1 tsp soy sauce  	- Salt and pepper, to taste 	- 4 chicken thighs (bone-in, skin-on) 	- 300g cubed potatoes 	- 200g green beans Method: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). 2. In a small bowl, combine olive oil, minced garlic, chicken seasoning, paprika, mixed herbs, salt, and pepper to make a marinade. 3. Brush some of the marinade over the chicken thighs, ensuring they are well-coated. 4. In a baking tray, add the cubed potatoes and green beans. Pour over the remaining marinade and toss to coat evenly. 	 5. Place the chicken thighs on top of the vegetables, skin-side down. 6. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes.   7. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Crispy pasta tubes filled with a light Philadelphia cream and dipped in coffee – one of my favorite desserts! ☕✨ Ingredients: - 250 g long pasta tubes - Oil for frying - 400 ml heavy whipping cream (33–35%) - 1½ packs Philadelphia cream cheese (about 300–350 g) - 80–120 g powdered sugar - 1 tsp vanilla sugar or vanilla extract - 150–200 ml strong, chilled coffee - Cocoa powder or grated chocolate for topping Instructions: 1. Fry the pasta tubes in hot oil until golden and crispy. Let them cool completely. 2. Whip the cold heavy cream until soft peaks form. 3. Mix the Philadelphia cream cheese with the powdered sugar and vanilla. 4. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture. 5. Quickly dip the pasta tubes into the cold coffee for 1–2 seconds. 6. Pipe the cream into both ends of each tube. 7. Dust with cocoa powder or grated chocolate and chill for 20–30 minutes before serving. #EasyDessert #CoffeeDessert #HomemadeTreat #CreamCheese #DessertLover

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Half are Kinder Bueno… half are Nutella… but which one would you grab first? 🤤  Ingredients * 500 g all-purpose flour * 7 g instant yeast * 60 g sugar * 1 tsp vanilla extract * 1 tsp salt * 2 eggs * 220 ml warm milk * 70 g softened butter Filling * Kinder Bueno spread * Nutella For coating * Melted butter * Granulated sugar Instructions 1. Combine the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. 2. Add the eggs, warm milk, and butter. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth and elastic. 3. Cover and let the dough rise for 1½–2 hours, or until doubled in size. 4. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a smooth ball. 5. Place on parchment paper, cover, and let rise again for 30–45 minutes. 6. Heat oil to 170°C (340°F) and fry for about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown. 7. Drain on paper towels, brush lightly with melted butter, and coat in sugar while still warm. 8. Once slightly cooled, use a piping nozzle to make a hole in each Bombolini and fill 4 with Kinder Bueno spread and 4 with Nutella. 9. Serve immediately and enjoy the gooey center! #nutella #bomboloni #donuts #Recipe #baking

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Enchiladas Rojas Enchiladas Rojas  📝Ingredientes Para la salsa:     ●    8 chiles guajillos     ●    4 chiles puya     ●    2 tazas de agua     ●    3 dientes de ajo     ●    1 cucharadita de orégano     ●    1 pizca de comino     ●    Sal al gusto Para las enchiladas:     ●    Tortillas de maíz     ●    Aceite, el necesario para freír     ●    1 queso fresco Casero @elmexicanobrand, desmoronado Para servir:     ●    Lechuga, finamente picada     ●    Crema Mexicana @elmexicanobrand     ●    Queso fresco Casero @elmexicanobrand, desmoronado 👩🏻‍🍳 Instrucciones     1.    Prepara los chiles: Coloca los chiles guajillos y los chiles puya en una ollita con agua y déjalos hervir hasta que estén suaves.     2.    Prepara la salsa: Una vez que los chiles estén listos, colócalos en la licuadora junto con 2 tazas del agua donde se cocieron, los 3 dientes de ajo, el orégano, el comino y sal al gusto. Licúa muy bien hasta obtener una salsa suave.     3.    Cuela la salsa: Pasa la mezcla por un colador para retirar cualquier resto de semillas o piel de los chiles.     4.    Fríe las tortillas: Calienta un poco de aceite en un sartén. Sumerge una tortilla en la salsa de chile y, de inmediato, colócala en el sartén. Fríe aproximadamente 1 minuto por cada lado y retira.     5.    Rellena las enchiladas: Coloca un poco de queso fresco Casero desmoronado sobre la tortilla, enrolla y acomoda en un plato. Repite el proceso hasta terminar la salsa.     6.    Sirve: Agrega lechuga picada, Crema Mexicana y más queso fresco Casero desmoronado por encima. #enchiladas #enchiladasrojas #EasyRecipe #fyp

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Nashville Hot Chicken Mac & Cheese  Recipe ⬇️ Ridiculously creamy four-cheese mac and cheese with a crispy golden cheese crust, topped with crunchy fried chicken coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil! Mac & Cheese 16 oz cavatappi pasta 4 tbsp butter 4 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 8 oz mozzarella 4 oz Fontina 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Dijon mustard ½ tsp chicken bouillon Salt & black pepper Reserved pasta water Fried Chicken 2 lb chicken tenderloins 2 cups buttermilk 2 tbsp hot sauce 2 cups flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tbsp paprika 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne Salt & black pepper Oil for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp salt Directions Cook pasta 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook 1–2 minutes. Slowly add evaporated milk, cream, milk and seasonings. Simmer until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to low and melt in 16 oz of the shredded cheese. Reserve the other 16 oz for layering. Fold in pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to keep it extra creamy. Layer half the mac in a baking dish, add 6 oz reserved cheese, then remaining mac and 10 oz cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 1–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes. Mix flour, cornstarch and seasonings, then coat chicken thoroughly. Fry chicken at 350°F for 4–6 minutes until crispy and 165°F internally. Combine Nashville hot oil spices in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour ½ cup hot frying oil over the spices and stir until combined. Brush or toss the fried chicken in Nashville hot oil, then pile it over the baked mac and cheese. Enjoy! 🔥 #nashvillehotchicken #macandcheese #friedchicken #comfortfood #recipe

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

An aquarium filter quietly removes far more waste than most people realize. A stainless steel mesh pre-filter captures fish waste, leftover food, plant debris, and other solid particles before they reach the main filtration system. As these materials accumulate, the filter becomes filled with dark, murky sludge, showing just how much pollution it has prevented from remaining in the water. During routine maintenance, aquarists open ball valves to flush out this collected waste in a process known as backwashing. Although the discharged water looks unpleasant, it is evidence that the filter is working effectively. Regular cleaning prevents clogs, supports efficient filtration, maintains stable water quality, and helps create a healthier environment for aquarium fish.

Which is your favorite Charmander, Charmeleon or Charizard? I think I like Charmander the most! Then somehow we end up with Charizard filling almost the entire piece, wings spread out, claws up, tail on fire, and literally breathing another stream of flames over everyone else. That size jump is exactly why the Charmander evolution line works so well for this sand art design. All three Pokémon share the same warm orange-red family, so they clearly belong together, but each stage gets progressively sharper, larger, and more aggressive. Charmander is round and cheerful. Charmeleon gets the deeper red coloring, horn, claws, and much more serious expression. Charizard completely changes the silhouette with giant wings, a longer neck, bigger body, blue wing membranes, and enough fire to make the whole top half of the artwork feel chaotic. Every colored section is filled with sand. The orange and red bodies make up most of the composition, but the smaller details really help separate the stages: cream-colored bellies, blue-green wing sections, white claws, pink mouths, dark outlines, and several shades of yellow, orange, and red in the flames. There’s also something especially satisfying about doing Pokémon evolution art this way because you aren’t just watching one character get colored. You’re gradually seeing an entire transformation story appear section by section. The little Charmander at the bottom gives you the starting point, Charmeleon bridges the gap, and Charizard becomes the huge visual payoff. For anyone into Charmander, Charmeleon, Charizard, Pokémon evolution lines, Fire-type Pokémon, Pokémon fan art, colored sand art, satisfying art processes, nostalgic gaming characters, visual ASMR, or handmade character art, this one combines pretty much all of it.

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Water first. Substrate second. 💧🌱 This is personally my favorite way to add substrate, especially for a no CO₂, no-filter aquarium. I start with about 2 cm of water, then add the substrate directly into it. The water immediately traps most of the fine particles, instead of letting a cloud of dust spread everywhere. I also don’t rinse my substrate, because I prefer to keep everything it contains rather than washing part of the fine material away. Less dust. Less mess. Nothing wasted. Just water first. 🌿 Would you try it this way? New project in collaboration with @aquasistema_es 💚 #aquarium #aquascape #aquascaping #fishtank #plantedtank

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Herb Roasted Chicken Ingredients 	1 whole chicken, 3-4 lbs 	1 stick butter, softened 	3 cloves garlic, grated 	6 sprigs rosemary, chopped 	Salt 	Pepper 	2 cups chicken broth 	1 onion, quartered Instructions Place the chicken in a baking dish. Mix the butter, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper, then rub all over the chicken. Pour the broth into the bottom of the pan and add the onion. Bake at 375 for 90 minutes, or until fully cooked. Pour off the drippings for gravy and cover the chicken with foil to keep warm. Yorkshire Puddings Ingredients 	3 eggs 	Flour, equal weight to eggs 	Milk, equal weight to eggs 	Pinch of salt 	Avocado oil Instructions Weigh the eggs, then add equal weights of flour and milk. Add the salt and whisk until smooth. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Add 1 tbs avocado oil to each muffin cup and heat at 425 for 5 minutes. Pour the batter into the hot oil and bake for 15 minutes, or until puffed and golden. Crispy Roast Potatoes Ingredients 	5 lbs yellow potatoes, peeled and chopped 	2 tbs cornstarch 	1 tsp salt 	1 tsp garlic powder 	1 tsp paprika 	1/2 tsp pepper 	Avocado oil Instructions Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes, or until fork tender, then drain. Gently toss with the cornstarch and seasonings to rough up the outsides. Add enough avocado oil to coat the bottom of a baking dish and heat at 425 for 5 minutes. Carefully add the potatoes and roast for 1 hour, tossing every 15 minutes, until crispy and golden. Cauliflower Cheese Bake Ingredients 	2 heads cauliflower, chopped and steamed 	2 tbs butter 	2 tbs flour 	1 3/4 cups half and half 	4 oz Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 	8 oz cheddar cheese, shredded 	Salt 	Pepper Instructions Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and whisk in the flour to form a paste. Slowly whisk in the half and half and cook until thickened. Lower the heat and mix in 3/4 of the cheese, salt, and pepper until melted. Pour over the cauliflower in a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes, then broil for 2 minutes until golden.

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken
